compute_mae: compute the mean absolute error between predicted and target tensor values for MLIP model evaluation
compute_mse: compute the mean squared error between predicted and target tensor values for MLIP model evaluation
compute_cosine_similarity: compute the cosine similarity between predicted and target tensor vectors for directional property comparison
compute_per_atom_metrics: compute per-atom MAE or MSE metrics normalized by atom count for fair system-size comparison
evaluate_energy_forces_threshold: evaluate the fraction of systems where energy error is below 0.02 and max force error is below 0.03
